name: OpenAI Codex
help: Sign in with Codex first. The collector reads its local OAuth account. Leave the folder empty to use the default.

name: Claude Code
help: Use local Claude Code logs. Enable account usage to include subscription quotas, and select the Claude Code executable to renew that sign-in when it expires. A status-line snapshot is the fallback.

name: Claude Fable
help: Uses the model-specific limit reported by the Claude account. Enabling this source opts into account quota access.

name: Grok Build
help: Select your installed Grok executable after completing its sign-in.

name: Grok Bot
help: Uses your linked Cursor session for Bot billing. The session stays on this Mac. Cursor versions that encrypt the saved sign-in cannot be read.

name: Cursor
help: Uses the signed-in desktop client. The data file is optional for standard installations. Cursor versions that encrypt the saved sign-in cannot be read.

name: Antigravity
help: Select agy after signing in. If agy requests workspace trust, open it in ~/Library/Application Support/AIUsageDashboard/agy-workspace and review the prompt.

name: Kimi Code
help: Provide a Kimi Code key or use the existing collector configuration.

name: DeepSeek API
help: Reads the balance of the official API account associated with this key.

name: OpenAI API
help: Uses an organization admin key for API billing usage.

name: OpenCode Go
help: Uses the official OpenCode Go subscription usage endpoint.

name: OpenRouter
help: Reads the usage available for the configured key.

name: GitHub Copilot
help: Uses your existing GitHub billing access.

name: Muse allowance
help: Choose a local JSON file for manually maintained weekly quota and referral balance. The app shortcut is a separate choice.
